name: Aurelius Technologies Berhad
summary: Aurelius Technologies Berhad, an investment holding company, offers electronic manufacturing services for industrial electronic products in the United States, Malaysia, the Asia-Pacific, and Europe. It offers manufacturing services, including printed circuit board assembly, sub-assembly, and box-build services; and system build products, as well as test development and testing, proto and NPI support, further processing, and lean manufacturing. The company also provides new product introduction, art surface mount technology, test systems development, engineering, and supply chain and quality management services.
